hero.title: Runaway Timmy:
hero.subtitle: A fast-paced, cartoon-style 3D mobile endless runner inspired by Subway Surfers. Escape an enraged Granny through vibrant modular European town streets, dodging multi-lane obstacles, swimming waterways, collecting coin trails, and stacking mystery power-ups!

openingVideo.title: Timmy Opening Cutscene
openingVideo.captionText: Cinematic opening sequence capturing Timmy's coin heist and Granny's furious pursuit.

gameplayVideo.title: Timmy Gameplay Demo
gameplayVideo.captionText: High-speed endless runner gameplay, lane switching, obstacle avoidance, and dynamic water swimming.

introduction.heading: Runaway Timmy: The High-Speed Town Escape
introduction.leadParagraph: Runaway Timmy is an action-packed, cartoon-style 3D mobile endless runner inspired by arcade classics such as Subway Surfers. Built from the ground up in Unity, the game focuses on rapid-fire reflexes, precise multi-lane maneuvering, dynamic obstacle avoidance, rich coin collection, and exhilarating stackable power-ups.
introduction.secondaryParagraph: Players take control of Timmy as he sprints endlessly through a playfully designed modular European town. Each run dynamically generates charming cobblestone streets, sharp corner turns, and refreshing canal water sections where Timmy transitions seamlessly from sprinting to swimming. The overarching objective: survive as long as possible, collect coins, chain power-ups, and rack up the highest score while keeping just one step ahead of Granny!

pillar.title: Fast-Paced Traversal
pillar.description: Immediate swipe responsiveness, high-speed momentum curves, and smooth jump/slide animations tuned for mobile gameplay.

pillar.title: Modular European Town
pillar.description: Dynamic procedural street blocks, scenic canals, plaza arches, and corner turns keeping every single run fresh and unpredictable.

pillar.title: Multi-Terrain Swimming
pillar.description: Fluid water sections where Timmy dives into town canals, introducing unique aquatic obstacles and buoyant lane navigation.

synopsis.heading: The Coin Jar Heist & Granny's Pursuit
synopsis.quote: "Caught red-handed with his fingers in Granny's coin jar to buy the new gaming console, Timmy had only one choice: run like the wind through the town before Granny catches up!"

paragraphs.p: Timmy is an energetic, mischievous young boy with one burning dream: getting his hands on the latest gaming console. Short on pocket money, he makes the cheeky decision to swipe coins from his Granny's cherished coin jar. But Granny has eagle eyes—and boundless stamina!

Caught in the act, Timmy bolts out the front door and sprints into the bustling European town. Hot on his heels, Granny chases after him with relentless determination. Players must guide Timmy through winding streets, leap over roadblocks, duck under low awnings, and surf the canals.
Every mistake matters: colliding with obstacles depletes Timmy's health and lets Granny close the gap, cranking up the urgency and intensity with every second on the run!

mechanicsSystem.subtitle: Intuitive swipe controls, responsive multi-lane switching, and dynamic health feedback.

control.title: Jump Over Obstacles
control.desc: Leap over traffic barriers, low street roadblocks, and parked cars.

control.title: Slide Underneath
control.desc: Slide low to effortlessly pass beneath overhead scaffolding and arches.

control.title: Switch 3 Lanes
control.desc: Dart swiftly between 3 parallel lanes to grab coins and dodge collisions.

control.title: Water Swimming
control.desc: Smooth aquatic locomotion allowing Timmy to navigate river hazards and waterways.

healthDetails.failCondition: Game Over when all 3 Hearts are depleted
healthDetails.recovery: Heal pickups restore +1 Heart up to max 3
healthDetails.visualFeedback: Timmy's facial expressions and animations change dynamically reflecting his current health condition

obstaclesSystem.subtitle: Multi-layered obstacles strategically placed across lanes to test reflexes and timing.

type.name: Jump Obstacles
type.desc: Road barriers, construction fences, and parked vehicles requiring precise jump timing.

type.name: Slide Obstacles
type.desc: Low-hanging signs, scaffoldings, and market canopies that must be ducked under.

type.name: Water Obstacles
type.desc: Floating buoys, logs, and canal barriers that cannot be jumped over—demanding instant lane-switching while swimming.

powerupsSystem.subtitle: Collect shiny coin trails and combine mystery power-ups for unstoppable runs.

item.name: Coins
item.title: Gold Coin Trails
item.desc: The core collectible. Placed strategically across lanes and high jump arcs to boost total score and currency.

item.name: Skateboard
item.title: Skateboard Rush (5s)
item.desc: Grants 5 seconds of hyper speed and complete invulnerability! Smashes through obstacles on contact instead of taking damage.

item.name: Double Coin
item.title: 2x Coin Multiplier
item.desc: Doubles the value of all coins picked up for a limited duration, maximizing high scores.

item.name: Shield
item.title: Protective Shield
item.desc: Absorbs the next incoming obstacle collision without losing a health heart.

item.name: Magnet
item.title: Coin Magnet
item.desc: Automatically vacuums all nearby coins from all 3 lanes directly to Timmy.

item.name: Bomb
item.title: Obstacle Blast Bomb
item.desc: Triggers an explosive shockwave that obliterates all upcoming obstacles in front of Timmy.

item.name: Heal
item.title: Heart Restore (+1 HP)
item.desc: Recovers 1 lost health point, keeping Timmy alive and resetting Granny's proximity.

stackingFeature.title: Stackable Ability Synergy
stackingFeature.desc: Collecting multiple Mystery Boxes stacks their active powers together—combine Magnet + Double Coin + Skateboard to trigger the ultimate unstoppable coin frenzy!

environment.subtitle: Modular stylized European town assets modeled in Blender, custom toon shaders, and vibrant lighting in Unity.
